correctness.rationale: The line segment avoids the inner ball iff its angular separation is at most the sum of two tangent angles. The uniform directional cap measure and radial densities give the identity. Coupled radial quantiles prove strict monotonicity. Direct radial moments derive both rational formulas, checked via exact rational common-denominator certificates. For all odd dimensions, integration of the odd sine power yields squared moments with rational products. Dominated cap asymptotics give the stated gamma/binomial constant; finite Monte Carlo only diagnoses the formulas.
